answer: Concrete sybil resistance via canyon anchoring: each agent must lock a canyon stake of 15,000 POA for 18 epochs; the stake erodes 4% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. A karst of 12 rooted validators samples each epoch's output; divergent outputs are calcified and the stake burns 25%. At the sable of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 48 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 15,000N POA for 18 epochs and survive 12 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
